rungs.mechanisms: Ephemeral context; bounded tools; action/evidence log; independent result check.
rungs.certification_focus: Explicit instruction following and externally checkable outputs.

rungs.mechanisms: HG0 + persistent episodic/task/self state; checkpoints; scoped retrieval; provenance; restart recovery.
rungs.required_memory: Cross-session episodic/state continuity, temporal order, provenance-aware retrieval.

rungs.mechanisms: HG1 + evidence-linked consolidation; semantic promotion; verified procedures; fixed learning rule.
rungs.required_memory: Semantic consolidation, procedural memory, update handling, useful transfer.
rungs.certification_focus: Verified experience measurably improves later related work.

rungs.mechanisms: HG2 + candidate cognitive/organizational modification lane; frozen replay/hidden tests; independent evaluator/promoter.
rungs.required_memory: Failure, hypothesis, change, benchmark result, version and rollback lineage.

rungs.mechanisms: HG3 + explicit improvement engine Psi; longitudinal change ledger; meta-improvement benchmark.
rungs.required_memory: Longitudinal memory of improvement strategies and validated effectiveness.
rungs.certification_focus: Improvement of the improvement process across generations.

rungs.mechanisms: HG4 + unknown/hypothesis/experiment/knowledge state; experiment selector; novelty environment; discovery verifier.
rungs.certification_focus: Independent discovery of previously unknown mechanisms or methods.

rungs.mechanisms: HG5 + mission manager; goal/project/task generator; portfolio/resource state; persistent organization; dynamic replanning.
rungs.primary_levels: Mission autonomy; SA6; T6; advanced O.
rungs.required_memory: Persistent mission/project/role commitments, portfolio state, organizational history.
rungs.certification_focus: Mission -> projects -> tasks under changing conditions with little human cognition.

rungs.mechanisms: HG6 + bounded charter; opportunity model; knowledge-to-instrument transduction; new-agent/role proposals; frozen governance.
rungs.required_memory: Open-ended lineage across evolving memory/cognitive instruments, discoveries, missions and roles.
rungs.certification_focus: Repeated charter-to-mission cycles that expand future reachable problems.
